title: Facade at a layer boundary
purpose: Show chess UI accesses logic through facade above platform layers.
alt: 체스 UI와 Chess Logic 사이의 Facade, XML·GTK·Linux·Hardware로 이어지는 계층 구조
requiredChecks: Top-to-bottom layers: Chess User Interface, Facade boundary, Chess Logic, XML Reading/Writing and GTK GUI Toolkit peers, Linux, Hardware.

XML and GTK remain separate peer components above Linux.
Layer ordering and names match original; no inverted platform hierarchy.
